payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates integers from a+1 upward, checking if the mask of the number (formed by extracting '4' and '7' digits) equals b. Simple brute-force linear scan.
payload.rationale: The solution performs exhaustive search over consecutive integers. Among the given complete_search subtypes, none perfectly matches this naive linear scan; 'search_bitmask_enumeration' is the closest available, despite no bitmask operations being used.
